name: onepass
description: PreToolUse gate on Agent/Task: allows at most ONE refutation/verification/audit subagent spawn (description or subagent_type matching refut|verif|audit|adversar|反証|検証|監査) per user prompt and denies the second, quoting the rule 「1度の反証とテスト、証明できなければ破棄、テストがREDなら起票」「何段階も深くほらない」. A UserPromptSubmit hook resets the per-session counter. Fail-closed: unreadable/unwritable state or an unparseable payload denies. Non-matching spawns are never touched.
